source: Vendor HTDW3532 parameter image, plus maintainer-supplied measurements and confirmations on 2026-09-14.

mass_source.basis: Maintainer measurement, 2026-09-14: one production HTDW3532 weighs about 141 g, and all 15 motors on this robot are the same specification.
mass_source.supersedes: The 0.15 kg figure transcribed from the vendor parameter image, which was not a measurement.
mass_source.effect: Model total mass 3.886339783 -> 3.751339783 kg. Motor centers of mass stay at their CAD positions and motor inertias are rescaled by mass ratio, following mass_override below, so every link that carries a motor changed slightly in mass, center of mass, and inertia. Link geometry, joint definitions, and the zero-pose envelope are unchanged.

sustained_torque_observation.what_it_does_not_establish: A continuous torque rating or a thermal limit. It is a single observation at one torque level, not a duty-cycle curve; the rated figure below stays 0.6 N*m.

peak_or_stall.note: Peak/stall data are not continuous URDF effort ratings. The vendor image does not supply an allowed duration; the observation above is the only duration evidence recorded so far. The URDF effort column keeps using the rated 0.6 N*m.

no_load.note: No-load speed is not the continuous rated URDF velocity limit.

urdf_policy.effort: Use rated output_torque_nm; per-joint values may be more conservative.
urdf_policy.velocity: Use rated output_speed_rpm * 2*pi/60; these are gearbox output values, so do not apply gear_ratio again.

mass_override.center_of_mass: Preserve each motor component CAD center of mass.
mass_override.inertia: Estimate each motor inertia tensor about its CAD center of mass by multiplying the CAD tensor by mass_kg / CAD mass. Then aggregate links with the parallel-axis theorem.
mass_override.limitation: Actual internal mass distribution was not supplied. This uniform-density scaling is an estimate, not a measured motor inertia.

electrical_and_control.accuracy_note: Vendor image labels both accuracy rows (Nm/A); percentage values are transcribed without reinterpreting the units.
